summary: Iteration 11 verifies the typography/density lift and reduced seed data. Backend regressions clean: test_multi_scheme.py (14 pass + 1 skip), test_review_flow.py (12/12), tests/test_fetch_metadata_auth.py (17/17 via its own runner — note pytest cannot collect it due to a custom `results` fixture; run as `python tests/test_fetch_metadata_auth.py`). Per-officer /api/reviews?state=pending totals: official@=6, sjsa@=3, agri@=2 (all ≥2). /api/monitoring/overview total=51 (in 36–60), by_scheme rows=3, recent_transactions length=5. Frontend: fonts load correctly — Plus Jakarta Sans (body/h1 font-family + document.fonts.check=true), Noto Sans Devanagari (brand caption renders, non-zero width, family listed), JetBrains Mono is set on .mono elements (TXN-… IDs) and renders visually though document.fonts.check("13px 'JetBrains Mono'") returned false — appears to be a lazy-load timing quirk, not a real bug (fallback stack Courier New/monospace fills in until load). Zero elements with computed font-size <12px scanned across /login, /citizen, /citizen/applications/<id>, /citizen/new, /operations, /operations/transactions, /operations/exceptions, /operations/reviews, /operations/connectors, /operations/health, /operations/policy — at BOTH 1920x1080 and 390x844. Zero horizontal overflow on any of those routes at either viewport (scrollWidth == clientWidth). Body font-size 16px desktop / 15px mobile; [data-testid=page-title] 28px desktop / 24px mobile on all citizen and operations pages. Login layout: role buttons stack single-column both viewports (x-left equal, y increasing, heights ≥71px). Officer department picker (officer-skill / officer-social_justice / officer-agriculture) stacks vertically inside officer-department-picker; selecting officer-agriculture sets email input to agri@demo.in; login lands on /operations/reviews with page-eyebrow='AGRICULTURE · MAHARASHTRA'. Citizen list simplified: application-search + application-status-filter + application-scheme-filter all ABSENT on /citizen; my-applications-title='My applications' present above the list; application-count populated ('18 applications'). Operator /operations/transactions still has all three filters and application-count='51 transactions'. New application page: section titles 'Applicant details', 'Choose a service', 'Application details', 'Data-sharing consent', 'Your service journey' all present; summary-stage-0..3 each render '<n><name> · <system>' on one visual line (h=22–39px). option-select and district-select heights=47px (≥44). End-to-end citizen submit → officer sanction confirmed: citizen@demo.in submitted MH_DRIP_IRRIGATION_SUBSIDY (Sugarcane/Pune) → Under department review; agri@demo.in opened a case → review-panel visible, review-remarks (h=84px), review-sanction (h=40px), review-reject (h=40px); typed remarks + clicked sanction → transaction-status='Completed' inside 15s; case page shows 'Sanctioned by the department', officer name, benefit ₹40,000. Sidebar user block at 1920x800 is NOT clipped (user block bottom=786 within viewport 800). No visible text clipping or badge wrapping detected in screenshots.

ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844 [data-testid=login-submit-button] computed height = 40px. Review request spec says '(44px mobile)' for buttons. Below the mobile touch target guideline by 4px.

At 390x844 [data-testid^=apply-] links (apply-MH_SKILL_BENEFIT, apply-MH_POST_MATRIC_SCHOLARSHIP, apply-MH_DRIP_IRRIGATION_SUBSIDY) each have bounding height = 36px. Review request requires ≥44px on mobile. 8px short.
[data-testid=nav-citizen], nav-new, nav-notifications each have bounding height = 43px on the mobile viewport — 1px below the 44px touch target guideline. Borderline, but flagged for completeness.

On /operations/transactions/<TXN> the review-remarks textarea has rendered height = 84px. Review request expects ≥90px (initial height guidance in spec). It still expands on typing and does not block flow.
At 1920, the login page 'Sign in to Sampark' heading rendered at 26px (spec expected 28px desktop). On every other page [data-testid=page-title] is 28px — only the login variant is 2px smaller.

integration_issues.issue: citizen@demo.in currently returns 18 applications (application-count='18 applications'). Review request expected 3–4 rows (3 seeded + a few created earlier). This is accumulated test debris from iterations 8–10 and this run creating live sanction flows — NOT a code regression. A fresh `python seed_dataset.py --reset` would bring it back to the expected 3–4.

issues: summary-stage-1 and summary-stage-2 render at 22px height while summary-stage-0 and summary-stage-3 render at 39px — the taller ones include an inline icon block. Visually consistent but height differs; if a uniform row height is desired, set min-height on .summary-stage.

action_items: Increase [data-testid^=apply-] link height on /citizen mobile from 36px → ≥44px (add py-2 or min-height:44px).
Nudge sidebar nav item min-height from 43 → 44px at ≤760px.
Optionally bump [data-testid=review-remarks] initial rendered height to ≥90px (rows={4} or min-height:96px).
Optionally sync login page h1 to the 28px scale used by page-title.
Run `cd /app/backend && python seed_dataset.py --reset` if you want the citizen list to reflect the target 3–4 rows for a clean demo; otherwise ignore.
critical_code_review_comments: tests/test_fetch_metadata_auth.py uses a home-grown `results` fixture that pytest cannot resolve — running via pytest reports 15 ERRORs (setup failures) even though the file works as a standalone script (17/17 pass). Recommend either wiring `results` as a real pytest fixture or renaming test functions so pytest skips collecting them (add `pytest_collection_modifyitems` filter), to prevent noisy CI failures.

document.fonts.check for JetBrains Mono returns false right after networkidle on /citizen even though the font-family cascade is set correctly and TXN- text renders. Consider adding <link rel=preload> for the .woff2 or a font-display:swap fallback verification to avoid FOUT flicker on slow networks.

The API /api/exceptions returned an empty list from the requests client, while the Overview page shows '6 Needs attention'. Frontend appears to hit a different endpoint (or applies stricter filters server-side). Not a regression but worth verifying the two views stay consistent.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14+1 skip multi_scheme, 12/12 review_flow, 17/17 fetch_metadata via script, per-officer inbox totals verified via requests)
success_rate.frontend: ≈95% (all typography/overflow/data-count/layout assertions pass; 4 small touch-target/height deviations from the spec on mobile/misc)

test_credentials: citizen@demo.in, operator@demo.in, agri@demo.in, sjsa@demo.in, official@demo.in — Demo@2026!
seed_data_creation: One additional MH_DRIP_IRRIGATION_SUBSIDY application created and fully sanctioned during E2E (APP-MH-2026-707A60F09D91 route). Aditi's live count rose to 18. No seed reset performed (per review-request instruction).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Typography lift (Plus Jakarta Sans / Noto Sans Devanagari / JetBrains Mono) is landed and passes the systematic checks: (a) no computed font-size <12px on any tested route at 1920 or 390, (b) no horizontal overflow at either viewport on the 12 routes listed, (c) body=16/15px, page-title=28/24px, buttons desktop ≥40px, inputs ≥44px. Reduced data seeds are landing at total=51 (36 seeded + accumulated test creations across previous iterations). Officer per-department inboxes stay ≥2. Only follow-ups are the 4 small touch-target / min-height polish items in action_items — none block the demo.
rca of the issue: Not a bug-fix run; visual/regression pass. Root causes for the minor deviations noted: (1) mobile min-height rule in /app/frontend/src/government-theme.css targets .btn/.form-input but LoginPage submit and .apply link classes don't inherit the .btn min-height at ≤760px — either extend the selector list in the 'Readability layer' or add explicit min-h-11 utility. (2) review-remarks uses <textarea rows=3> — 3 rows × ~24 line-height + padding = ~84px; setting rows=4 or min-height:96px matches the spec. (3) LoginPage h1 uses a bespoke class, not the page-title token; consolidate to [data-testid=page-title] scale.
